### The problem
Doing a post call to a URL with a colon (such as https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Welcome) doesn't ever use the cache result. I can see the cached response in Sqlite but it doesn't seem to be picked up

### Expected behavior
The second duplicate call returns a response from the cache

### Steps to reproduce the behavior
The following fails to use the cached result:

```
session = requests_cache.CachedSession(
    'test_cache',
    allowable_methods=('GET', 'POST'),
)
data = "{}"
resp1 = session.post("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Welcome",data=data)
print('First:', resp1.from_cache)
print(resp1.status_code)

resp2 = session.post("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Welcome",data=data)
print('Second:', resp2.from_cache)
print(resp2.status_code)
```

Switching the URL to something like "https://httpbin.org/post" does work

### Workarounds
_Is there an existing workaround for this issue?_

### Environment
- requests-cache version: 1.2.1
- Python version: 3.12
- Platform: Ubuntu 24.04
